name: PRAXIST
title_zh: 研究结论必须跑出代码才肯写进报告
tagline_zh: 受够了调研报告全是「据分析」「或可」？它把每个论断变成可执行脚本，跑不通的结论自动标红，你拿到的是能复现的证据链。
tagline_en: Tired of reports full of 'perhaps' and 'analysis suggests'? This turns every claim into a runnable.
desc_en: Autonomous research system for measurable, computer-executable research.
why_zh: 它不产出观点，产出可验证的产物。每个结论都绑定一段可执行代码，机器能跑的才算数，从机制上掐死含糊其辞。
why_en: It doesn't produce opinions—it produces verifiable artifacts. Every claim is bound to executable code; if the machine can't run.
limit_zh: 只认能用代码表达的研究问题，纯思辨、伦理、审美类议题它直接罢工；需要本机有 Python 环境和网络。
limit_en: Only for research expressible as code—pure philosophy, ethics, or aesthetics will make it refuse. Requires local Python + network. Outputs scripts &.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Research that must run code before it writes a word
